method_limits: the population is E505's own published face: a surface appears here because that face classed it argument-only, not because this study re-read E505's rows

the first declared parameter is treated as the population handle; E505's surface record carries only an arity, so every other argument is published beside it and a surface whose first parameter is not the population is visible in its kinds_by_parameter

a call is attributed by import form only: a direct name needs a from-import of the surface module or a same-module site, and an attribute call needs the receiver to be an in-repo module alias; calls reached through getattr, a star import, or a dynamic dispatch are out of this reader's reach and are not counted as either present or absent
a tree walk is attributed one hop: a callee's body is checked for a walk call, but a walk hidden two calls deep reads as a plain call result

only the tree is read: a surface called only from git history, a notebook, or a scheduled task's command line has no site here, which the reach axis says explicitly rather than folding it into 'never called by code in the tree'
the population parameter is not type-checked; a module constant reaching it may hold something other than names, and every constant is published with the expression that supplied it
title: Read the call sites of E505's 35 argument-only population surfaces: what value does each caller hand the surface, and is the population recoverable from a call site?
